slice: A16 — ADM-01 users, roles, quotas, suspensions and signup approval

lab.topology: one origin (a pipe-only proxy on :3200 in front of `node .next/standalone/server.js` on :3100 and vidra-core on :8088), because vidra_refresh is SameSite=Lax and Path=/api/v1/auth
lab.postgres: native PostgreSQL 16.15 on a private port, fresh cluster, migrated to schema 129
lab.redis: native redis on a private port, flushed before seeding
lab.media: TRANSCODING_ENABLED=true with ffmpeg 8.1 — every quota and quarantine assertion below is about real stored bytes from the shipped pipeline
lab.frontend: production build (`next build`) served from .next/standalone with .next/static and public copied in, exactly as the Dockerfile does
lab.browser: real Chromium, hard reloads, one signed-in session at a time
lab.rate_limits: left at shipped defaults and never raised: general 120/min per IP, auth 10/min per IP

actors.M: mona — instance owner, claimed with OWNER_CLAIM_TOKEN; role 'admin' (there is no separate owner role)
actors.D: dana — moderator, promoted through the shipped PATCH /admin/users/{id}
actors.A: avery — ordinary user with a channel and real uploads
actors.C/E: cass / erin — throwaway accounts used for the controlled tombstone probes
actors.P/Q/rowan2: pat / quinn / rowan2 — signup applicants (approved, rejected, approved through the UI)

role_matrix_as_shipped.assignable: admin.ValidRole accepts exactly those three; 'owner' and 'superuser' are 422
role_matrix_as_shipped.owner: the instance owner is the FIRST account and holds role 'admin'; nothing distinguishes it afterwards

guards.last_admin: NO GUARD SHIPS — admin A may demote admin B, including the instance owner; only the self-change guard prevents zero-admin lockout
guards.owner_protection: NO GUARD SHIPS — the owner is demotable and deletable by any other admin
guards.tombstone_reactivation: refused 422 (NEW in this slice; was 200 on origin/main)

totals.note: the three 'failed' rows are (1) one lab-format bug about psql boolean rendering, restated and passing in its addendum, and (2)+(3) the two DELIBERATE baseline reproductions on the origin/main binary, where the defect answering 200 IS the finding

rate_limit_429s.explanation: 8 are the deliberate SC5 burst (two runs of 14 attempts, 10 refusals then 4 throttles each); the rest are the harness's own probes waiting for that window to drain, plus one browser sign-in that collided with it. No assertion outside the rate-limit phase saw a 429.
